out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the dish area is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Person in charge provided access to hand washing sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw salmon stored above cut tomato in 2 door flattop unit (left side) at the deli counter.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge placed salmon below all prepped and cooked food items.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: deli turkey (45F), roast beef (47F), deli ham (47F), block smoked Gouda (49F) in deli display.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge discarded all items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: display case (47F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Person in charge removed all items from cooler and submitted a maintenance request. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine was observed at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Person in charge ordered irreversible thermometer during inspection.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: cooked egg patties, cooked mushrooms, cooked vegetables observed held in 2 door sliding refrigerator at deli section dated for 8/12, 8/16 which is more than 7 days specified by the code.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Foods were discarded.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): cheese pizza, pepperoni pizza held for 2 hours at room temperature. EHS observed pizza at 81F on service line.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS discussed using time OR temperature to keep food safe. PIC was provided with Fairfax County TPHC template at the time of inspection. Staff were informed of the proper procedures to follow and will be trained on the process, including marking foods for discard time.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The ambient (air/water) temperature measuring device located in the following unit is not accurate in degrees F: Cold Protein walk-in refrigerator thermometer showing a constant temperature below 0 degrees F.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/-3 degrees F in the intended range of use. Repair or replace the thermometer in the walk-in. Alternatively, a new, hanging, ambient air thermometer may be placed inside the unit. BALDUCCI'S (Inspection Date: 08/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip or dish-simulating thermometer available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: rubber seals of refrigerator frames, wall behind 3-compartment sink where chemicals are held, and plastic lining on shelves.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
